# hg reconcile

**What this page tells you:** every `hg reconcile` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The destination host's reconcile timer.

## Synopsis

```text
hg reconcile install [flags]
hg reconcile run [flags]
hg reconcile status [flags]
hg reconcile sync [flags]
hg reconcile retry [flags]
hg reconcile prove [flags]
hg reconcile uninstall [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

`install` writes and starts the timer, `run` applies once in the foreground, `sync` forces a cycle — and is SKIPPED, never queued, while the timer holds the lock. `status` reports the last outcome; `prove` verifies the loop actually applies.

## `hg reconcile install`

```text
hg reconcile install [flags]
```

Write and start the reconcile timer.

A re-install (a version bump through pulumi) may omit flags and keep the stored config; a first install must name the repo.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--instance` | `<name>` | — | Named repository watcher; omitted selects the existing default. All instances share the deployment lock. |
| `--repo` | `<url>` | — | The repository the loop applies. |
| `--branch` | `<name>` | `main` | Branch to track. |
| `--interval` | `<seconds>` | `60` | Tick interval. |
| `--checks` | `'a,b'` | — | Comma-separated pre-apply check commands. |
| `--apply` | `<cmd>` | — | The apply command the loop runs. |
| `--version` | `<rev>` | — | Version the install is pinned to. |
| `--harness-home` | `<dir>` | `~/.hermes` | The harness home whose `.env` carries `GITOPS_GIT_TOKEN` (the legacy Hermes home by default). |
| `--kube-context` | `<name>` | — | Kube context for post-apply health checks. |
| `--status-namespace` | `<ns>` | — | Namespace status records are published into. |
| `--timeout` | `<seconds>` | `900` | Argo CD health timeout after an apply. |
| `--now` | — | — | Enable and start immediately (`--enable` is a value flag elsewhere; mirrors `systemctl enable --now`). |

**Examples**

```bash
hg reconcile install --repo https://github.com/org/persona.harness-hg --now
hg reconcile status
```
